TZA.note: Mentions disability grants and welfare services only; nothing on information or digital accessibility.
States no digital payment fact; PSSN cash transfers named without payment method.
Gives only a household connection fee, no rural access share.
Notes absence of an integrated system but states nothing on data exchange between systems.
No programme management information system is described.

facts.fact: PMO-LYED lists the absence of an integrated social protection system, i.e. a Unified Social Registry, among Tanzania's challenges.
